summary: Frontend-only regression for the new SortFilterBar (sort A-Z/Z-A/Latest/Oldest + From/To date range) rolled out across (a) Summer Camp CRM Bookings sub-tab, (b) Future Skills CRM list tabs, and (c) Orders → Student Payments; plus the new green '+ Add Customer' converted flow in Summer Camp and the updated invoice PDF company header. All four review items behave as specified.

Cleanup: QA Test Customer row deleted via row trash icon + 'Yes, Delete' confirm modal; count returned to 73 / Converted 8. No residual test data.

Future Skills (/admin/future-skills) Leads tab shows data-testid='fs-sort-filter'; 'Name (A → Z)' via data-testid='fs-sort' reorders NAME column (['Aahaan Khan','Alpika Jain','AM. NIKHIL','Amisha Solanki','Anish','Anjali Rohra','Ashita Kothari','Asma Shaikh'] — matches sorted). Date range 2020-01-01→2030-12-31 keeps 60 rows; narrowing to 2100-01-01→2100-12-31 drops to 0.

Non-list tabs Centres, Batch Requests, Centre Economics, (etc.) do NOT show fs-sort-filter (verified).

Orders → Student Payments (data-testid='student-payments-tab'): data-testid='student-payments-sort-filter' present with sub-testids. STUDENT column re-ordered A-Z (matches sorted). Latest → Oldest sets top row correctly. Wide date range shows 31 rows; range 1990-1991 shows 0. Sub-tabs student-sub-tab-home / summer_camp / future_skills all continue to show the sort/date bar. School Payments tab correctly HIDES the bar (count=0).

critical_code_review_comments: SortFilterBar.applySortFilter: date filter uses `if (!t) return false;` — rows without any of the candidate date fields (created_at/createdAt/booked_at/date) will be filtered OUT whenever ANY From/To value is set. Currently harmless because every booking/lead has created_at, but if a legacy row is missing the field it will silently disappear. Consider treating missing dates as 'include when any filter set' or make the behaviour explicit in the util's JSDoc.

The Summer Camp KPI card is a plain <button>/<div> without a data-testid; only the KPI-summary '+ Add Customer' button has one. Consider adding data-testid='camp-kpi-converted' on the Converted KPI card itself for more deterministic Playwright selectors.
seed_data_creation: Created one Summer Camp booking 'QA Test Customer' via Add Customer flow (booking #0074) and DELETED it via the row-level Yes,Delete modal — DB state restored to 73 bookings / 8 Converted.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Feature works end-to-end. Common gotchas for re-testing: (1) admin login is at /admin/login (email+password); the /login route is a phone-OTP flow. (2) The Summer Camp 'Converted' KPI (count 8) is a different element from the top-level Student CRM 'Converted' tab (count 9) — locate by Summer Camp scope. (3) FS admin tab names are 'Centres & Batches', 'Batch Requests', 'Source Links', 'Centre Economics' (no 'Reports' tab). (4) applySortFilter drops rows that don't have any of the candidate date fields whenever From or To is set — see code-review note.
